title: Polar Flow Workout Calories Burned Leaderboard
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=polar:activity calories_kcal=*
| stats sum(calories_kcal) as total_value, avg(calories_kcal) as avg_value by sport_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks sport values by total and average calories burned across Polar Flow workout events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `calories_kcal` values for each Polar Flow workout event and review total and average calories burned by sport.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total calories burned.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts which sport shows the biggest calories burned numbers in your Polar Flow workout data.
